options.reason: The table is a TCGA expression matrix assembled for subtype prediction: ~17.8k gene-level expression features per tumour plus a five-level PAM50 label, so multiclass classification of PAM50 from expression is the evident task. sample_id is a row key only and is excluded from features; no gene column is a recode of the target, so no leakage columns are flagged. Model selection happens within TCGA and the locked model is then applied once to the external CPTAC cohort (which lacks Normal-like), so no grouping or time columns are needed.
options.title: multiclass
